80775.subject: Tokenization Briefing: 10 Trillion Dollar Tokenization Market?
80775.body:
----------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b35d8526-fea4-4141-81d2-c5bf58b65a37/unnamed__23_.png?t=1789408235)
Follow image link: (https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/tokenization-briefing)
Caption: 


--------------------
GM. Last Thursday, the IMF issued its third warning on tokenization this year, finding that tokenized markets are growing quickly but remain small, fragmented and significantly more volatile than the underlying assets they track. On Monday, Morgan Stanley told The Block that the market will reach $3 trillion to $10 trillion by 2030 “without question”.

In today’s issue, we cover what the IMF thinks could break as tokenization scales, how fast the market would need to grow to hit Wall Street’s 2030 forecasts, and which of the largest tokenized Treasury funds actually record ownership onchain.

Thanks for subscribing!


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9a149ab2-e0fc-4007-bb17-f3c41ce3dbb4/image.png?t=1791919203)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

----------
# ==Top of Mind==

## _The IMF Says Tokenization’s Biggest Constraints Aren’t Technical_

On October 8, the IMF published Chapter 3 of its Global Financial Stability Report, “Scaling Tokenization: New Efficiencies, New Vulnerabilities.” It puts publicly reported tokenized assets at about $65 billion as of July, excluding stablecoins and repo. Tokenized credit accounts for $30.4 billion and money market funds for $17.5 billion, while tokenized equities total just $2.3 billion.

Investors are using the features tokenization offers. More than half of tokenized equity trading happens outside traditional market hours, and about 80% of the trades the IMF analyzed were for less than one share.

Tokenized equities were shown to be about 1.5 times as volatile as the underlying assets, with liquidity split across platforms and networks that don’t interoperate.


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/de75c65a-240b-498a-bd3d-59b09379994b/image.png?t=1791919233)
Caption: 

----------
The IMF also warned about certain risks associated with tokenization. While today’s process of sequence of messaging, trading, delayed settlement, and reconciliation adds cost, it also acts as a sort of a safety buffer. Round-the-clock settlement could lead to “fire sales, liquidity runs, and contagion through interconnectedness and leverage.”

The report advocates for building tokenized collateral carefully. The IMF’s constraints are the ones the market is already working through, from the CFTC’s collateral guidance to DTCC’s launch this month. Its warning is that increased speed cuts can have negative effects too, so margin and liquidity safeguards will need to be implemente

80774.subject: The best and worst protocol revenues in a bear market
80774.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/35c36e68-4459-4482-9303-1439d9677139/Top_Gate.png?t=1791911328)
Follow image link: (https://www.gate.com/money)
Caption: 

We used LlamaAI’s improved analysis capability in Research mode to understand which protocols have durable revenue during market downturns: when Bitcoin drops and DEX volume falls, who still earns revenue?

Including protocols with at least 12 months of revenue history and over $1m in revenue, here’s what we found:

See the Analysis (https://defillama.com/ai/chat/shared/287c6bbb-e43f-4075-87c6-0a8478ff258f#msg-bac8c559-a185-43f6-8531-1d845e1be701)

## Which protocols are insensitive to downturns?

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/25ee1227-4770-42cb-8c00-1a9ad38681e8/revenue-change-in-the-dex-volume-downturn_2026-10-13.png?t=1791902597)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/ai/chat/shared/287c6bbb-e43f-4075-87c6-0a8478ff258f#msg-bac8c559-a185-43f6-8531-1d845e1be701)
Caption: The largest 24 protocols by trailing 1y revenue

Among 227 protocols analyzed, median revenue change is -62% during the DEX volume downturn from October 2025 to May 2026, and -65% in the BTC downturn (October 2025-July 2026).

Most protocols lose revenue during downturns. But not all - for the largest 24 protocols by trailing 1y revenue, there are a few standouts:

Reserve-yield issuers earn from interest rates, not onchain activity.

Growth in underlying supply (Paxos PAXG, Ripple USD) increases reserve size and revenue earned. [PAXG](https://defillama.com/protocol/paxos?groupBy=weekly) AUM & revenue nearly doubled during the downturn.

TCG’s like Courtyard and Collector Crypt’s revenue is a function of Pokemon cards exploding in popularity and value, [revenue is up 2-3x YoY](https://defillama.com/protocol/collector-crypt?fees=false&revenue=true&groupBy=monthly) for Collector Crypt.

DefiLlama tracks [fomo app revenue](https://defillama.com/protocol/fomo?groupBy=weekly&revenue=true&fees=false) going back to January 2025. In October 2025, fomo monthly revenue totaled $700k. 

From August 26th-October 2nd 2026, fomo earned over $700k every single day.

fomo revenue increased steadily throughout 2026, but activity increased at lightning pace as DEX volume began to return in late August. By the 4th of September, fomo’s DEX volume [briefly rose to over 4% of total DEX volume](https://defillama.com/ai/chat/shared/2b8ba4da-6058-46a8-800e-7342004da3f1#msg-250d7747-170c-4083-ba25-ae5d52e7f478). Just two months earlier, fomo’s daily share was 0.5%.

Wallets, yield protocols, trading apps, DEXs, and derivatives are the categories most affected by activity downturns.
